idKarta.label: ID card
idKarta.info: The client's profile in one place: basic company details, contracts, key contacts, and an overview of contracted services with upcoming deadlines.

termini.label: Appointments
termini.info: All concrete deadlines for this client — past and future. Each row is one appointment with a due date, status (planned, scheduled, overdue, completed), and an assigned person. Appointments are generated from the checks defined in the Services tab.

lokacije.label: Locations
lokacije.info: The client's facilities and business units where checks and visits take place. Each location can have its own address and contact person, and appointments can be linked to a specific location.

kontakti.label: Contacts
kontakti.info: All of the client's contact persons: company contacts (director, responsible persons…) and contacts for individual locations. Location contacts are edited in the Locations tab.

dokumenti.label: Documents
dokumenti.info: All documents linked to the client — manually added files and AI-generated records. The Source column shows whether a document was uploaded or generated by AI.

podsjetnici.label: Reminders
podsjetnici.info: Sending reminders to this company (toggle + addresses) and assigning the workers who work with the company.

profil.label: Services
profil.info: The definition of recurring checks for the client: which type of check is performed, at which location, and at what interval. Appointments are generated automatically from these entries. “Last time” is the last actual completion, “Next deadline” is the due date of the active appointment.
